# Auxiliary lab evaluation A — two paid runs, one honest comparison.
#
# THE DELIVERABLES. Two real Sunday Relay files, sliced byte-identical, so the
# diff this mission produces applies straight back to the repository. Both are
# committed stubs whose every function throws; the seeded specifications are
# written and currently fail. The second depends on the first, so the two must
# be implemented in dependency order.
src/relay/mission/julius/julius-run-comparison.ts
src/relay/mission/julius/julius-run-comparison-text.ts

# THE DEPENDENCY. The authority on what a run cost and whether the figure is
# complete. It is sliced so the comparator can import it — and so the seeded
# specifications can build their inputs with the repository's own functions
# rather than an imitation of them. It is not a deliverable and it is not to
# be edited; its own header states the rule that settles the stale note.
src/relay/mission/julius/julius-cost-accounting.ts
